recommendation_summary: Have `nightly-sync` write a dated success marker to the Synology, and run a daily check on the NAS after the deadline that emails the user if today's marker is missing; keep the existing summary email and test the alert by withholding the marker.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker; neither is needed to detect a missed run.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own email, so a startup crash also silences the alert.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing inspected; I’m using your account of the four missed runs and your two machines.

note: The reply recommends one dead-man check run as a scheduled task on the NAS, with no Docker and no logging stack, so I counted it as SMALL even though it is hosted on the user's own NAS.
